safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated contains no family history statement (section is empty).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the statement that there is no significant family history has minimal clinical relevance in an acute insect sting/allergic reaction assessment and is unlikely to change management. This is primarily a documentation completeness issue.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not explicitly state the patient is speaking normally.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting that the patient is speaking normally removes an important negative/red-flag descriptor used to assess airway compromise in possible anaphylaxis. While other parts of the encounter suggest stability, loss of this detail could modestly impair downstream triage/clinical handoff.
